chat_tasks_task_gone.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. A task action failed because the task was deleted.

chat_tasks_task_manual.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. Task panel badge: the task has no schedule and runs only when someone starts it.

chat_tasks_task_paused.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. Task panel badge: someone paused the task's schedule.

chat_tasks_task_stopped.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. Task panel badge: the task stopped itself because its stop condition was met.

chat_tasks_time_in_zone.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. A time of day in a time zone other than this computer's; {{zone}} = an IANA name such as Europe/Paris.

chat_tasks_title.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. Heading of the task panel opened from the chat toolbar's clock button.

chat_tasks_unmute_reports.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. Report strip menu item shown instead of Stop reporting here once the task's reports are stopped in this conversation: they start appearing here again.

chat_tasks_unmuted_toast.message: This task will report in this conversation again
chat_tasks_unmuted_toast.description: Location: Chat. Tasks (background or scheduled jobs) created in a conversation: the chat toolbar's task panel, and the strip above a task's report message in the conversation. Confirmation after Resume reporting here.

chat_thinking.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Status shown beside the assistant's name while it is working, when no more specific activity is known. Ends with an ellipsis character; keep whatever your language uses.

chat_tool_call_failed.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Status of a tool the assistant ran while composing its reply. All three are aria-labels on a small status icon, so they must stay short. The tool ended in an error.

chat_tool_call_running.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Status of a tool the assistant ran while composing its reply. All three are aria-labels on a small status icon, so they must stay short. The tool is still running.

chat_tool_call_succeeded.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Status of a tool the assistant ran while composing its reply. All three are aria-labels on a small status icon, so they must stay short. The tool finished successfully.

chat_trace_consent_body.message: Phi will save this conversation's trace (your messages, the replies, page content and tool results) as a log file and send it to the Phi team with your feedback.
chat_trace_consent_body.description: Location: Chat. The card phi-agent shows before this conversation's trace is shared with the Phi team (the chat_trace.export tool). Card body: what is in the trace and where it goes.

chat_trace_consent_dont_share.description: Location: Chat. The card phi-agent shows before this conversation's trace is shared with the Phi team (the chat_trace.export tool). Button: do not share; nothing is sent.

chat_trace_consent_note_label.description: Location: Chat. The card phi-agent shows before this conversation's trace is shared with the Phi team (the chat_trace.export tool). Label of an optional text box where the user can add a note to the report.

chat_trace_consent_share.description: Location: Chat. The card phi-agent shows before this conversation's trace is shared with the Phi team (the chat_trace.export tool). Button: share the trace.

chat_trace_consent_title.description: Location: Chat. The card phi-agent shows before this conversation's trace is shared with the Phi team (the chat_trace.export tool). Card title: asks whether to share this conversation's trace.

chat_unsupported_part.message: This content isn't supported in Phi Chat yet ({{type}}).
chat_unsupported_part.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Shown in place of a piece of a reply the app cannot display; {{type}} = the technical name of that content kind, which stays untranslated.

chat_user_action_allow.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Prompt shown when the assistant needs the user's permission before it can go on. Button: grant the permission and let the assistant continue.

chat_user_action_deny.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Prompt shown when the assistant needs the user's permission before it can go on. Button: refuse the permission. It reads "Cancel" in English rather than "Deny"; keep that softer wording.

chat_user_action_title.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Prompt shown when the assistant needs the user's permission before it can go on. Heading of the prompt; {{name}} = the assistant's display name.

chat_welcome_subtitle.message: You can search, ask questions, or work with the current page
chat_welcome_subtitle.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Greeting at the top of a conversation that has no messages yet. Second line, hinting at what the assistant can do.

chat_welcome_title.description: Location: Chat. The conversation view: the message timeline and the composer beneath it. Greeting at the top of a conversation that has no messages yet. Greeting line; {{name}} = the assistant's display name. The assistant is speaking about itself.

context_menu_ask_about.description: Location: Chat. Items Sidecar adds to the browser's right-click menu: asking the assistant about selected text, and having it watch the current page. Default menu action before a selection preview is available; {{agentName}} is the assistant's name.

context_menu_ask_about_selection.description: Location: Chat. Items Sidecar adds to the browser's right-click menu: asking the assistant about selected text, and having it watch the current page. Menu action with a selected-text preview; {{agentName}} is the assistant's name and {{selection}} is the selected text, possibly truncated.

context_menu_watch_page.description: Location: Chat. Items Sidecar adds to the browser's right-click menu: asking the assistant about selected text, and having it watch the current page. Menu action shown when the user right-clicks a web page (no selection). The assistant will keep checking the page in the background and report important changes; {{agentName}} is the assistant's name.

conversation_add_category.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Button/menu: create a new category.

conversation_add_category_confirm.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirm button that creates the category.

conversation_add_category_placeholder.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Input placeholder for a new category's name.

conversation_all_category.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Category filter chip meaning 'no category filter'.

conversation_batch_delete_error.message: Failed to delete the selected conversations
conversation_batch_delete_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Error text when deleting the selected conversations fails.

conversation_batch_mode.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Conversation row menu item in the Phi Chat list: enter multi-select mode with that row selected. Keep short.

conversation_by_profile.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Section heading above browser Profile filters in the conversation filter chooser.

conversation_cancel.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Dialog dismiss button.

conversation_categories.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Section header of the category list.

conversation_categories_menu.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Submenu (conversation row menu, chat toolbar menu) and multi-select toolbar button listing the user's categories as checkboxes. A conversation can be in several categories; none checked means Uncategorized.

conversation_category_menu.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. aria-label of the active category chip's kebab menu button.

conversation_category_name_conflict.message: A category with this name already exists.
conversation_category_name_conflict.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Validation error: duplicate category name.

conversation_category_update_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Banner or toast when adding a conversation to a category, or removing it, failed; nothing was changed.

conversation_clear_categories.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Last item of the multi-select Categories menu: removes every category from all selected conversations, which leaves them Uncategorized.

conversation_close_search.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. aria-label of the close button inside the conversation search dialog.

conversation_conversation_menu.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. aria-label of a conversation row's kebab menu button in the list pane.

conversation_create_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Error text when creating a conversation fails.

conversation_delete.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Menu item / button: delete the conversation.

conversation_delete_batch_confirm_descri.message: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} conversation(s)? This action cannot be undone.
conversation_delete_batch_confirm_descri.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirm-dialog body; {{count}} = number of selected conversations.

conversation_delete_batch_confirm_title.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirm-dialog title before deleting the selected conversations.

conversation_delete_category.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Menu item: delete a category.

conversation_delete_category_confirm_des.message: Conversations in this category keep their other categories. Those left without one move to "{{category}}".
conversation_delete_category_confirm_des.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Category deletion confirmation. A conversation can be in several categories and only loses this one; {{category}} is the localized protected Uncategorized view that holds conversations with no category left.

conversation_delete_category_confirm_tit.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirm-dialog title before deleting a category.

conversation_delete_confirm_description.message: Are you sure you want to delete this conversation? This action cannot be undone.
conversation_delete_confirm_description.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirm-dialog body; warns the delete is permanent.

conversation_delete_confirm_title.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirm-dialog title before deleting one conversation.

conversation_delete_selected.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Tooltip and aria-label of the delete button in multi-select mode; {{count}} = number selected.

conversation_deselect_all.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Button (tooltip and aria-label) in multi-select mode, shown when every loaded conversation is selected: clear the selection.

conversation_exit_batch_mode.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Button: leave multi-select mode. Keep short.

conversation_filter_conversations.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Accessible action label for opening the conversation filter chooser.

conversation_has_tasks.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Accessible label of the clock icon after a conversation's title: tasks (background or scheduled jobs) were created in this conversation and report into it.

conversation_load_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Error text when the conversation list fails to load.

conversation_load_more.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Button at the end of the conversation list pane or of the search results that fetches the next page.

conversation_loading.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Generic loading indicator text.

conversation_more_categories.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. aria-label of the overflow button that lists the category chips that do not fit in the row.

conversation_move_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Error text when moving a conversation to another category fails.

conversation_move_to_default.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Menu item to remove custom categorization; {{category}} is the localized protected Uncategorized category.

conversation_move_to_profile.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Submenu in the standalone Phi Chat list that gives a conversation without a Profile to one browser Profile; Profile means the browser Profile, as elsewhere in this catalog.

conversation_my_categories.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Section heading above user and built-in conversation categories in the filter chooser.

conversation_no_conversations.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Empty state when the user has no conversations yet.

conversation_no_search_results.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Empty search result; {{query}} = the search text.

conversation_no_task_conversations.message: Ask the agent to do something on a schedule, and the conversation will appear here
conversation_no_task_conversations.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Empty state of the built-in Tasks view: a conversation appears here once the agent was asked in it to do something on a schedule (a task linked to the conversation).

conversation_origin_chat.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Origin badge next to a conversation title: the chat was started in the Phi Chat window (the chat workspace page). Product name: keep as is.

conversation_origin_newtab.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Origin badge next to a conversation title: the chat was started on the new-tab page. Shown only when the list is viewed from another surface.

conversation_origin_sidebar.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Origin badge next to a conversation title: the chat was started in the browser's sidebar panel. Shown only when the list is viewed from another surface.

conversation_pane_title.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Heading of the conversation list pane on the chat workspace page.

conversation_phi_chat_management_hint.message: For conversations across all Profiles and more management options, use Phi Chat.
conversation_phi_chat_management_hint.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Informational footer in the sidebar conversation picker. Phi Chat is the application name. Profile refers to a browser Profile. This is not a clickable launch control.

conversation_profile_category_name.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Profile filter label in the conversation list and its selected view; {{name}} is the browser Profile's display name. Keep the Profile prefix and quotation marks to distinguish this from user categories.

conversation_recent_conversations.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Expandable section header for the recent list in the sidebar top-bar dropdown; expanded by default.

conversation_rename.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Menu item / dialog title: rename the conversation.

conversation_rename_category.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Menu item: rename a category.

conversation_rename_description.message: Enter a new name for this conversation.
conversation_rename_description.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Helper text inside the rename dialog.

conversation_resize_list.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. aria-label of the vertical divider that resizes the conversation list pane.

conversation_retry.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Button that retries a failed conversation list load.

conversation_retry_profiles.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Action shown when browser Profiles could not be loaded; choosing it retries loading without changing the conversation selection.

conversation_save.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Dialog confirm button: save changes.

conversation_search_filters.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Search field hint in the chooser listing browser Profiles and conversation categories. Profile is a browser feature name.

conversation_search_label.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. aria-label of the conversation search input.

conversation_search_placeholder.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Placeholder of the conversation search input.

conversation_search_shortcut.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Tooltip of the search button; {{shortcut}} = the keyboard chord, for example ⌘K.

conversation_select_all.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Button (tooltip and aria-label) in multi-select mode: select every conversation loaded in the list.

conversation_select_conversation.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Dialog title: pick a conversation.

conversation_select_placeholder.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Placeholder of the conversation <select> while none is chosen.

conversation_selected_count.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Heading of the conversation list while multi-select mode is on; {{count}} = number of selected conversations. Keep short, the pane is narrow.

conversation_switch_conversation.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Picker title and confirmation action for selecting another conversation without leaving the current web page.

conversation_switch_discard_draft.message: Your unsent text and attachments will be discarded. Switch conversations?
conversation_switch_discard_draft.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Confirmation before switching conversations when the composer contains unsent text or attachments. Switching discards that draft.

conversation_tasks_category.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Built-in conversation list view, shown right after 'All': conversations in which the assistant created a Task (a background or scheduled job managed in Sentinel). Not a user category; use the same word Sentinel uses for its Tasks page.

conversation_title_placeholder.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Input placeholder for the new conversation title.

conversation_travel_back_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Restore the conversation's latest web page and recorded split view. The page title is shown underneath the single entry. Toast shown when the browser could not reopen that page.

conversation_travel_back_latest.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Restore the conversation's latest web page and recorded split view. The page title is shown underneath the single entry. Single restore entry: resume the latest page and split view recorded on arrival, navigation, layout changes or sending a message.

conversation_travel_back_origin.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Restore the conversation's latest web page and recorded split view. The page title is shown underneath the single entry. Retired menu entry, no longer displayed: reopen the page the conversation was started on.

conversation_travel_back_sidebar_error.message: The page is open, but this chat couldn't be restored there. Your conversation is still here. Try again.
conversation_travel_back_sidebar_error.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Restore the conversation's latest web page and recorded split view. The page title is shown underneath the single entry. Toast when the destination page opened but continuing the conversation there could not be confirmed. The original conversation is kept; ask the user to retry rather than promising that opening the sidebar manually will recover it.

conversation_travel_back_target_unavaila.message: The original Space or Profile is no longer available. Your conversation is still here.
conversation_travel_back_target_unavaila.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Restore the conversation's latest web page and recorded split view. The page title is shown underneath the single entry. Toast when a conversation cannot return to its recorded browser workspace or browsing identity because that Space or Profile was deleted or the Space now belongs to a different Profile. The conversation is kept. Space and Profile are browser feature names.

conversation_uncategorized.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Name of the protected category receiving conversations whose browser Profile was deleted. It is separate from the default conversation group. Users can move conversations out, but cannot rename or delete this category.

conversation_unread.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Accessible label of the blue dot before a conversation's title: a background task reported into the conversation since it was last opened.

conversation_untitled.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Fallback title for a conversation without a name.

conversation_without_profile.description: Location: Chat. Conversation list, history browser, categories, and the rename/delete dialogs. Conversation filter selecting chats not assigned to a browser Profile, including chats created in Phi Chat and chats kept after a Profile was deleted.

conversations_categories_all.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Filter chip that shows conversations from every category. Keep very short.

conversations_categories_create.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Confirm button of the create-category dialog.

conversations_categories_default.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Name of the built-in category that holds conversations not filed anywhere else; {{name}} = the assistant's display name.

conversations_categories_delete.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Menu item and dialog title: delete the category.

conversations_categories_delete_confirm_.message: Conversations in this category will move back to "{{name}}".
conversations_categories_delete_confirm_.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Body of the delete confirmation; explains the conversations survive; {{name}} = the default category they return to. Keep the quotation marks around it, adjusting them to your language's convention.

Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a category.

conversations_categories_menu_label.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. aria-label of the button that opens the menu for one category.

conversations_categories_more_label.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. aria-label of the overflow button revealing categories that do not fit in the bar.

conversations_categories_name_conflict.message: A category with this name already exists.
conversations_categories_name_conflict.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Validation error when the typed category name is already taken.

conversations_categories_name_placeholde.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Placeholder of the text field holding the category name.

conversations_categories_new.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Button and dialog title: create a category.

conversations_categories_rename.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Category filter bar above the conversation list, and the dialogs for creating, renaming, and deleting a category. Menu item and dialog title: give the category a new name.

conversations_create_failed.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Error text when starting a new conversation fails.

conversations_empty.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Empty state shown when the user has no conversations at all.

conversations_load_failed.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Error text when the conversation list cannot be loaded.

conversations_load_more.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Button at the end of the list: fetch the next page of conversations.

conversations_menu_cancel.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Dialog dismiss button; closes it without saving.

conversations_menu_delete.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Menu item and confirm button: delete the conversation.

conversations_menu_delete_confirm_descri.message: Are you sure you want to delete this conversation? This action cannot be undone.
conversations_menu_delete_confirm_descri.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Body of the delete confirmation; warns that the deletion is permanent.

conversations_menu_delete_confirm_title.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Title of the dialog that confirms deleting one conversation.

conversations_menu_label.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. aria-label of the button that opens the menu for one conversation.

conversations_menu_move.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Menu item: move the conversation into a different category.

conversations_menu_rename.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Menu item and rename-dialog title: give the conversation a new name.

conversations_menu_rename_description.message: Enter a new name for this conversation.
conversations_menu_rename_description.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Helper text inside the rename dialog.

conversations_menu_save.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Rename-dialog confirm button.

conversations_menu_title_placeholder.description: Location: Chat. The conversation list pane: the list itself, its empty and error states, and paging. Per-conversation menu in the list, and the rename and delete dialogs it opens. Placeholder of the text field holding the new conversation name.

live_chat_badge.description: Location: Chat. Live mode: one conversation per browser Profile in which Phi writes its own notes about what the person is doing in the browser, and the person can reply to them or chat about anything else. The conversation is tied to no tab. Badge next to the live-mode conversation's title, in the top bar and the conversation list.

live_chat_move_turn_button.description: Location: Chat. Live mode: one conversation per browser Profile in which Phi writes its own notes about what the person is doing in the browser, and the person can reply to them or chat about anything else. The conversation is tied to no tab. Live mode: while Phi works on a turn the person sent in the live conversation, a button beside Stop moves that turn out to its own conversation so the live conversation is free again. Nothing restarts: the work goes on in the moved conversation, which opens in the background, and live mode continues on screen. Tooltip and aria of the icon button beside Stop. Imperative, short.

live_chat_task_result_caption.description: Location: Chat. Live mode: one conversation per browser Profile in which Phi writes its own notes about what the person is doing in the browser, and the person can reply to them or chat about anything else. The conversation is tied to no tab. Live mode: under a reply Phi copied into the live conversation from a standing request's own conversation (the request ran there; the live conversation shows the same result). A small caption names the standing request, and a button opens that conversation. Caption under the copied reply, naming the standing request it answers. {{condition}} is the request's condition in the person's own words, for example “I'm browsing movies or TV shows”; keep the quotation marks around it.

live_chat_task_result_open.description: Location: Chat. Live mode: under a reply Phi copied into the live conversation from a standing request's own conversation (the request ran there; the live conversation shows the same result). A small caption names the standing request, and a button opens that conversation. Button under the copied reply that opens the standing request's own conversation, where the request and every result of it are kept.

live_chat_title.description: Location: Chat. Live mode: one conversation per browser Profile in which Phi writes its own notes about what the person is doing in the browser, and the person can reply to them or chat about anything else. live_chat_wake_reading.description: Location: Chat. Live mode: one conversation per browser Profile in which Phi writes its own notes about what the person is doing in the browser, and the person can reply to them or chat about anything else. The conversation is tied to no tab. Activity line under Phi's name in the live-mode conversation while Phi works on its next note, one entry per phase. Phi speaks in the first person ('I'm …'), never 'Phi is …'. Phi, first person: reading what changed in the person's browsing. Trailing ellipsis.

live_chat_wake_recalling.description: Location: Chat. live_chat_wake_recalling_for.description: Location: Chat. message_invalid_source_reference.message: A source reference is invalid. Keep an existing marker, or escape it with a backslash to use literal text.

message_loading_phrases_p01.description: Location: Chat. Chat message rendering: actions, statuses, tool calls, sources, role card. Playful rotating status phrases shown beside the assistant's name while it prepares a reply; one is picked at random and swapped every few seconds. The English set uses aquatic and fishing wordplay. Each locale carries its own independently authored set of playful "working on it" phrases written in that language's natural spoken idiom, drawing on its own sayings and local cultural imagery; a loose water and fishing thread is welcome but not required. A locale's phrase is not a translation of the English phrase in the same slot and must not be aligned to it word for word. Keep each phrase short, casual, and natural in the target language, one short line, no trailing punctuation (the UI appends an animated ellipsis). Rotating loading phrase.
